answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks through staked vouching with joint liability: every new account must be endorsed by two established agents who post collateral, slashed if the newcomer proves fake. Reputation can wander across the network instead of sitting in one registry, as each sponsor becomes a mirror for the risk of the identities they vouch for. Spam accounts turn expensive, while honest newcomers still find sponsors drawn to the nectar of referral rewards.
